card.name: Concomitant use of interacting drugs
card.fires_on: Words in drug-interaction sentences about taking two drugs together, mainly the word 'concomitant' (its middle piece) and the next words 'use', 'drug(s)' or 'be' that follow it.

modes.label: Inside 'concomitant'
modes.description: The final piece of 'concomitant' when a label warns about using it with another drug.
